description: Source code for a Broadcom Wireless Driver Control Utility (wlc), including command handling, interface control, and wireless configuration functions.

methods.name: wlc_ioctl
methods.description: Performs ioctl operations on the wireless interface based on parameters.

methods.name: wlc_iovar
methods.description: Handles get/set operations for driver variables.

methods.name: wlc_bssiovar
methods.description: Handles get/set operations for BSSID-specific variables.

methods.name: wlc_vif_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a virtual interface.

methods.name: wlc_ssid
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSID of the wireless interface.

methods.name: wlc_maclist
methods.description: Gets or sets MAC address lists for filtering.

methods.name: wlc_bssmax
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of BSSs supported.

methods.name: do_command
methods.description: Executes a command based on user input.

methods.name: find_cmd
methods.description: Finds a command structure by name.
